description: The bar chart compares the execution times of two systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across three categories—Simple, Moderate, and Challenging—and a total. The horizontal axis lists the categories, while the vertical axis represents execution time, ranging from 20 to 60 with labeled tick marks at intervals of 10. The legend indicates that light blue bars represent NatSQL and dark blue bars represent TA-SQL. For the Simple category, NatSQL has an execution time of 60.21, and TA-SQL has 63.14. In the Moderate category, NatSQL's execution time is 39.64, and TA-SQL's is 48.60. For the Challenging category, NatSQL's execution time is 32.32, and TA-SQL's is 36.11. The Total execution time for NatSQL is 51.35, and for TA-SQL, it is 56.19. The bars are grouped by category, with NatSQL's bar appearing to the left of TA-SQL's in each group. The chart is rotated, with the x-axis labels and bars oriented diagonally from the bottom left to the top right.
